text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High packet loss detected from eu-west-2 egress to upstream ASN 64532 (CarrierZeta). Alert: sustained >12% packet loss, spike in 5xx for hosted API routes. Auto-created INC-2325. Paging alice-oncall-net :rotating_light:

alice-oncall-net: taking this. looking at runbooks now — runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/incidents/network/egress-pktloss

alice-oncall-net: quick telemetry: 
- 5xx rate in eu-west-2: baseline 0.3% -> now 11.6%
- p50 latency (text-gen): 180ms -> 420ms
- affected prefixes: 203.0.113.0/24 (edge-egress-1), 203.0.114.0/24 (edge-egress-2)
- impacted tiers: hosted API (partial), 3 dedicated tenants (tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c)

bob? (typing)

ben-network: I see BGP stateflaps to CarrierZeta peering. pulling traceroutes now.

alice-oncall-net: posting mtr/traceroute snippet: 
```
traceroute to 8.8.8.8 (8.8.8.8), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  0.5 ms  0.4 ms  0.4 ms
 2  192.0.2.1  1.2 ms  1.1 ms  1.0 ms
 3  198.51.100.2  3.4 ms  3.3 ms  3.3 ms
 4  * * *
 5  198.51.100.9 (198.51.100.9)  45.2 ms  46.1 ms  44.9 ms  <-- packet loss begins
 6  203.0.120.66 (203.0.120.66)  55.0 ms  62.3 ms  58.8 ms  (CarrierZeta ASN64532)
 7  8.8.8.8  60.0 ms  61.1 ms  59.9 ms
```

Observation: >10% loss at hop 5-6 corresponding to CarrierZeta aggregate edge.

carlos-sre: confirming telemetry from egress kproxy: up to 18% retransmits toward peer ASN64532 in the last 5m. Flow logs show packets dropped after 100kpps mark.

alice-oncall-net: initial severity P2 -> regional degraded. customer-impact: partial (hosted web API delays, some dedicated tenants seeing 502s). opening bridge if needed.

diane-cs: flagged to CS: which customers to call? tenant-b is on a dedicated instance with strict SLA. please keep me posted.

ben-network: suggested mitigations: 
1) shift transit for eu-west-2 through secondary provider ASN 64599 (CarrierTheta) via local export and community tagging.
2) temporarily prepend to CarrierZeta-announced prefixes to de-preference (if they still accept the routes).
3) adjust health-check LB failover to prefer edges that egress via CarrierTheta.

alice-oncall-net: agree. Ben, can you test a controlled route-map to prefer CarrierTheta for 203.0.113.0/24 and 203.0.114.0/24? We'll do canary for 10% of prefixes then ramp.

ben-network: on it. doing dry-run on router rtr-eu-azb-01. route-map snippet I will apply: 
```
route-map RM-PREFER-THETA permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-EU-EGRESS
 set community 64599:100 additive
!
ip prefix-list PL-EU-EGRESS seq 5 permit 203.0.113.0/24
ip prefix-list PL-EU-EGRESS seq 10 permit 203.0.114.0/24
```
Applying with commit window 30s, will monitor BGP convergence and packet loss.

ops-bot: scheduled change window created CHG-2325-01 by ben-network at 2325010120, approval auto (on-call).

ben-network: applying now. committing in 5...4...3...

ops-bot: BGP export route-map applied on rtr-eu-azb-01 by ben-network. change id CHG-2325-01.

alice-oncall-net: monitoring traffic — immediate drop in packet loss at probe points. extracting metrics: 
- 5xx back down to 3.1% in eu-west-2 (was 11.6%)
- retransmit to ASN64532 reduced to 2.6%
- traffic via CarrierTheta increased by ~22% for targeted prefixes

diane-cs: thanks. contacting tenant-b with interim mitigation status. flagged for escalation if degraded >10m more.

carlos-sre: running synthetic checks to ensure no regression: smoke tests pass, model inference p50 back to 210ms. will continue 15m cadence checks.

alice-oncall-net: next steps: 
- keep change in place for 1 hour while monitoring
- open ticket with CarrierZeta NOC referencing ASN64532-INC-2325, ask for packet drop root cause and capacity issue details
- schedule post-incident for routing policy and multi-transit failover automation
- update public status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2325 -> set to "Degraded - Partial Regional Networking"

ben-network: filed contact with CarrierZeta NOC (noc@carrierzeta.example) ticket CZ-98721 with our traceroute and MTR.

ops-bot: status update posted to #incidents and #general: "eu-west-2 egress: partial degraded. traffic shifted to backup transit. monitoring."

alice-oncall-net: handing off to ben-network for ongoing monitoring and communication with CarrierZeta. if loss recurs or change causes regression, tag me and carlos.

ben-network: taking over. will keep the change as long as metrics hold. preparing a shorter description for postmortem and runbook edits.

diane-cs: good work team. I'll coordinate customer comms + follow-ups for tenant-b.

incident-bot: INC-2325 updated: owner=ben-network, status=mitigated (regional shift), severity=P2.

alice-oncall-net: closing my on-call loop, moving to monitoring-only. final note: remind infra to add automated transitreroute policy so we don't have to manual apply route-maps next time.

ben-network: logging remediation actions to INC-2325, will attach config diffs and timeline.

ops-bot: CHG-2325-01 closed at 2325010380 by ben-network.

ben-network: last checks show stable. marking last action time.

ops-bot: summary message: "CarrierZeta egress packet loss escalated. Traffic shifted to CarrierTheta via BGP export route-map. No customer data loss. Some requests experienced transient 5xx. Incident ticket INC-2325 created and will be followed by postmortem." :white_check_mark:
